Context-aware caching

A cache stores the result of an expensive computation. Reusing it avoids repeating the same work.

Use a stable key

Use cacheKey to retrieve the result. Read the documentation for more details.

  1. Compute the key.
    • Include the input version.
  2. Store the result.
const cacheKey = "article:v1";
cache.set(cacheKey, result);

Invalidation

Invalidate the cache when the input changes. The next request will compute a fresh result.
